subject: ASETT International Forum Closing Address
overview: Spanish Labor and Social Economy Minister Yolanda Díaz delivered the closing address at the first ASETT International Forum, promoting the social economy as a cooperative and democratic alternative to contemporary global crises.

items.title: Introduction of Minister Yolanda Díaz
items.summary: SPEAKER_01 introduced Yolanda Díaz, Second Vice President and Minister of Labor and Social Economy, to close the first international ASETT forum.

items.title: Closing Address by Minister Yolanda Díaz
items.summary: Yolanda Díaz delivered her closing speech, framing the social economy as a structural alternative to capitalism that fosters solidarity, mutual aid, and democracy in the face of ecological, housing, and social crises.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Adjournment
items.summary: SPEAKER_01 thanked the minister and the international attendees, formally concluding the forum.
